scope: Independent search for additional Asia/Middle East, Africa and Americas/Oceania Malthusian/local-food aggregate evidence. Weak city/trade and broad national estimates were retained only as validation or rejection records.

training_requires: mappable historical boundary with quantified coverage
population or capacity interval for that same boundary
resolved trade, shock and urbanization caveats
date/technology compatibility with 1337 or the declared 1100-1500 window

additions.boundary: North Island, 20 EU5 locations; 107391.36/113729.0 km2 = 0.944273 mapped coverage
additions.evidence: Brown-Crema radiocarbon/site-frequency trajectories support logistic leveling in the northern horticultural zone around AD1500; local kumara, fishing, storage and environmental pressure are documented.
additions.why_not_training: No absolute 1450-1500 North Island count; late-contact 90-150k literature range is out of period and cannot be projected backward.

additions.boundary: 1100 km2 survey region contained in djenne EU5 location; mapped coverage 0.112123
additions.evidence: McIntosh-McIntosh archaeological population range for Jenne-jeno/satellites around AD800; African rice, fish/fish oil and cattle support local floodplain food.
additions.why_not_training: Out of period, urban/trade cluster, population applies to a 1-km settlement cluster rather than the 1100-km2 area, and rural catchment is unresolved.

additions.boundary: 104 km2 Bagan archaeological property contained in pagan EU5 location; mapped coverage 1.0 for the property only
additions.evidence: Hudson/UNESCO document 11th-13th c. dry-zone irrigation, water management and climate stress.
additions.why_not_training: Capital and regional trade/administrative hub; city estimates have no closed rural food catchment and regional transfers are unresolved.

rejections_and_non_promotions.reason: SPDRD gives relative population dynamics, not absolute counts; 1769 references are out of period.
AD800 urban/trade cluster and 1-km population estimate cannot supervise surrounding land at 1337; only validation retained.

rejections_and_non_promotions.candidate: Bagan city population or monument density
rejections_and_non_promotions.reason: City/capital and regional transfer dependence violate the city/trade-hub rule; only physical irrigation validation retained.
Rapoport/Gaubert point estimate has no defensible uncertainty interval or audited rural-only boundary; existing registry rejection remains correct.
Physical capacity models demonstrate technology but explicitly do not show observed saturation or an in-period census.

conclusion.interpretation: No additional record met the strict two-sided or one-sided 1337 training standard in this wave. This is a substantive result: the global evidence gap is evidence-limited, not closed by manufacturing labels. The three append-only records expand held-out physical/pressure validation across Oceania, Africa and Asia while preserving explicit rejection reasons.
